notes: NovaShell’s rendered theme pass tightens small-screen Relay flow, Library readability, and local credential boundaries without exposing a secret.
changes: Relay’s composer now stays in normal page flow so it cannot cover local-status actions on short Chromebook screens.
Relay adds a local Keyring panel that reports safe provider/model status and backup boundaries without revealing a key; its two-tap removal path deletes only NovaShell’s saved provider profile.
My Library’s drag-and-drop helper now sits cleanly beneath the folder title in Ultra Retro.
The Retro and Cobalt passes were rendered against Settings, Browse, My Library, App Explore, Pocket Archive, Orbit, and Relay before release.
First-run setup offers direct local Library, game setup, backup, and controller-help shortcuts; Orbit’s full-height station rail keeps its channel list reachable.
